label: Patch Pocket
description: A patch breast pocket is a separate piece of cloth sewn directly onto the chest of the jacket with its top edge left open, creating a visible, three-dimensional pocket shape. It is the most casual breast pocket option, at home on sport coats and unstructured jackets, and it pairs naturally with patch hip pockets for a fully sporting composition.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
